name: black-swan-causal-labs
description: Validated MCP tools for real-world evidence, pharmacoepidemiology and public health, from Black Swan Causal Labs.

plugins.name: nhanes
plugins.description: Analyze CDC NHANES the way NCHS does: correct survey weights, pooled cycles, design-based CIs and NCHS reliability flags. Validated against published NCHS estimates.

plugins.name: target-checklist
plugins.description: Score how completely a target trial emulation study reports what the TARGET guideline requires, with evidence for every item.

plugins.name: robins-i
plugins.description: ROBINS-I V2 (not V1): assess risk of bias in one result of a non-randomized cohort study, domain by domain.

plugins.name: openfda
plugins.description: Resolve FDA application numbers and product names to regulatory metadata across CDER, CBER and CDRH.

plugins.name: dag-studio
plugins.description: Causal DAG analysis: backdoor paths, adjustment sets and bias simulation, validated against dagitty. Hosted server; requires a trial token from Black Swan Causal Labs.
